topic: Reselling: your teen turning $20 into $200 — and learning how business actually works
caption:
Your teen could turn a $20 thrift store find into $150-200 on eBay or Facebook Marketplace.
HustleUp teaches them exactly what to buy, how to price it, and how to write a listing that sells.
They learn margin, marketing, and negotiation before they graduate high school.
Give them a head start → hustleup.us
